criteria.purpose: re-select the global synaptic scale w_scale blind to every benchmark (audit gap 6)
criteria.drive: a fixed random 10% (numpy default_rng(0)) of sensory-superclass neurons whose type is not driven by any benchmark (types in LOOM_TUNING, GUSTATORY_MN9_DRIVING, peptide sources, and prefixes JO-, LC, LPLC, SNpp, pC1, DNg02, L1, L2, L3, L5, Pm3, Mi1, Tm2) and whose subclass is not auditory, campaniform sensilla, labellar bristle, pharyngeal sensillum, taste peg, wind_gravity; 20 Hz Poisson for 1000 ms after 200 ms of silence
criteria.measure: whole-CNS rate (spikes/neuron/s) and fraction of neurons with >= 1 spike, over the driven 1000 ms
criteria.rule: the largest grid value with whole-CNS rate < 1 Hz AND fraction active < 0.10
criteria.consequence: a recommendation; adopting a value other than 0.3 requires recalibrating PEAK_HZ, b_adapt and the A2 working point
